crossRefs.note: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

people.name: Kenan
people.line: Son of Enosh, descendant of Seth

translations.web: and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.
translations.bsb: So Kenan lived a total of 910 years, and then he died.
translations.kjv: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.
translations.asv: and all the days of Kenan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.
